description: PROP-007's row in verification-architecture.md claims the frozen ledger fixture 'tests/fixtures/ledger-2026-07-03-snapshot.jsonl' is '(already created, committed)'. This is TRUE only relative to the WRONG repository. Verified: the file exists ONLY at /Users/anicca/anicca-project/.vcsdd/features/clip-post-verify-hardening/tests/fixtures/ledger-2026-07-03-snapshot.jsonl -- inside the anicca-project repo's own VCSDD spec-staging area (git remote origin = github.com/Daisuke134/anicca-products.git; commit e5680f73 'REV 4 -- frozen ledger fixture'). It does NOT exist anywhere under /Users/anicca/anicca/skills/earn/clip/ (confirmed via `find` across ~/anicca, ~/anicca-project, ~/.openclaw for the filename, and via `ls ~/anicca/skills/earn/clip/tests/fixtures` -> 'No such file or directory'), which is the actual target codebase for this entire feature (REQ-008 explicitly places the new reel_verify.py at ~/anicca/skills/earn/clip/reel_verify.py; run.sh, monitor.sh, and producer.sh all live there; git remote origin = github.com/Daisuke134/anicca.git -- a COMPLETELY SEPARATE git repository from anicca-project). This is directly provable by contrast within the SAME proof-obligations table: PROP-005's own citation of 'the EXISTING tests/test_n_instance_distinctness.sh (already committed...)' is genuinely real -- but ONLY under ~/anicca/skills/earn/clip/tests/test_n_instance_distinctness.sh (confirmed by Read, contains the exact INSTANCES=("" "myclaude" "clawrouter" "clawrouter-2") array the spec cites). Confirmed no such file exists anywhere under the .vcsdd staging tests/ tree (that tree contains ONLY the ledger fixture, nothing else -- confirmed via `find .vcsdd/features/clip-post-verify-hardening/tests -type f`). So PROP-005 and PROP-007, sitting in the exact same table describing the exact same feature's tests/ directory, silently resolve to two DIFFERENT real roots (the actual ~/anicca codebase vs. the anicca-project VCSDD staging area) with no text anywhere flagging this distinction or instructing anyone to copy the fixture across. An implementer who reads PROP-007's '(already created, committed)' parenthetical as license to skip creating the fixture in the real codebase (exactly the reasonable inference PROP-005's identically-worded parenthetical invites) will find PROP-007's Tier-1 unit test fails at runtime with a file-not-found error the first time it actually executes against ~/anicca/skills/earn/clip/, because the real, buildable feature has no fixtures/ directory at all yet.

evidence.snippet: PROP-007: "...into a version-controlled fixture file `tests/fixtures/ledger-2026-07-03-snapshot.jsonl` (already created, committed)..." -- real only at /Users/anicca/anicca-project/.vcsdd/features/clip-post-verify-hardening/tests/fixtures/ledger-2026-07-03-snapshot.jsonl (anicca-products repo), content otherwise byte-correct (verified: matches the 4-line Ground Truth snapshot exactly). PROP-005: "...EXTEND the EXISTING `tests/test_n_instance_distinctness.sh` (already committed...)..." -- real only at /Users/anicca/anicca/skills/earn/clip/tests/test_n_instance_distinctness.sh (anicca repo). Confirmed via `git -C ~/anicca-project remote -v` -> anicca-products.git; `git -C ~/anicca remote -v` -> anicca.git -- two distinct repositories.
